data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghada' which means 'to go, to proceed, to travel'. In the Islamic context, Ghadia represents a spiritual journey towards self-improvement and enlightenment. The name Ghadia carries the meaning “Journey, Travel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghadia usually hope their child will grow to embody journey, travel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
